title: Optimize DML compound primary-key prefix handling
constraints: Preserve qualified and commuted primary-key point lookup semantics
rationale: primary_key_column_name allocated a temporary Vec before joining qualifier parts and primary_key_row_id_from_eq_selection re-ran the same primary-key detection after a match.
steps: Replace Vec plus join with direct preallocated String construction for compound identifier qualifiers
Carry the matched primary-key column name forward instead of resolving the same expression again
Run focused DML primary-key lookup regression tests and cargo check
expected_impact: Reduces small allocations and duplicate schema/qualifier work in DML primary-key point lookup detection.
